zh: 客人来之前我把客厅收拾了一下。
en: I {tidied up|cleaned up|tidied|cleaned} the lounge before the guests arrived.

zh: 搬家之后我们终于安顿下来了。
en: We've finally {settled in|settled|settled down} after the move.

zh: 我们的新室友下周末搬进来。
en: Our new flatmate {moves in|is moving in|arrives} next weekend.

zh: 这个周末我得把车库整理一下。
en: I need to {sort out|clean out|clear out|tidy up|tidy|clean|organise|organize|clean up} the garage this weekend.

zh: 搬家的时候我们扔掉了很多旧东西。
en: We {threw out|threw away|chucked out|got rid of|chucked away|tossed out|dumped} a lot of old stuff when we moved.

zh: 你能把洗干净的碗碟收起来吗？
en: Can you {put away} the clean dishes, please?

zh: 上班前我把洗好的衣服晾出去了。
en: I {hung out|put out|hung up|hung} the washing before work.

zh: 我们出门前你把暖气关了吗？
en: Did you {turn off|switch off} the heater before we left?

zh: 你能把音乐调小点吗？宝宝睡着了。
en: Could you {turn down|lower} the music? The baby's asleep.

zh: 这里冻死了，你能把热泵调高一点吗？
en: It's freezing in here. Can you {turn up|crank up} the heat pump a bit?

zh: 我们的卫生纸又用完了。
en: We've {run out of} toilet paper again.

zh: 做完饭我把台面擦干净了。
en: I {wiped down|wiped|cleaned|wiped off|cleaned up|cleaned down|scrubbed} the bench after cooking.

zh: 昨晚我被锁在家门外了。
en: I got {locked out} of the house last night.

zh: 他们正在翻新我们街上那栋老别墅。
en: They're {doing up|renovating|fixing up|restoring} the old villa on our street.

zh: 该你倒垃圾了。
en: It's your turn to {take out|put out|empty} the rubbish.

zh: 周六我们在走廊里装了几个搁板。
en: We {put up|installed|fitted|hung|built|mounted} some shelves in the hallway on Saturday.

zh: 这张旧沙发快散架了。
en: This old couch is {falling apart|falling to bits|falling to pieces}.

zh: 厨房的水槽又堵了。
en: The kitchen sink is {blocked up|blocked|clogged|clogged up} again.

zh: 把窗户打开，给房间通通风。
en: Open the windows to {air out|air|ventilate|freshen up} the room.

zh: 因为下雨，我们待在家里看了部电影。
en: We {stayed in|stayed home|stayed at home} and watched a movie because of the rain.

zh: 我一整天都在到处跑着办事。
en: I've been {running around|rushing around|dashing around|running about} all day doing errands.

zh: 今晚我只想在沙发上躺着什么都不干。
en: I just want to {veg out|chill out|chill|relax} on the couch tonight.

zh: 走廊的灯泡烧坏了。
en: The bulb in the hallway has {burned out|burnt out|blown|gone}.

zh: 我肯定是在沙发上不知不觉睡着了。
en: I must have {dropped off|dozed off|nodded off|drifted off|fallen asleep} on the couch.

zh: 进来吧，门开着！
en: {Come in}, the door's open!

zh: 暴风雨的时候停电了。
en: The power {went out|went off|went down|cut out} during the storm.

zh: 他因为不付房租被赶了出去。
en: He got {kicked out|thrown out|evicted} for not paying the rent.

zh: 冬天到了，该把夏天的衣服收起来了。
en: It's time to {pack away|put away|store} the summer clothes.

zh: 我实在受不了楼上的噪音了。
en: I can't {put up with|stand|bear|tolerate|deal with} the noise from upstairs any more.

zh: 搬家的时候冒出来一些问题。
en: A few problems {cropped up|came up|arose|popped up} during the move.

zh: 这张旧沙发占了客厅一半的地方。
en: This old couch {takes up} half the lounge.

zh: 你走的时候把灯关掉。
en: {Turn out|Turn off|Switch off} the lights when you leave.

zh: 我们在Trade Me上把旧沙发免费送人了。
en: We {gave away} our old couch on Trade Me.

zh: 你能把洒出来的果汁擦干净吗？
en: Can you {wipe up|clean up|mop up} the juice you spilled?

zh: 在很多新西兰家庭里，穿鞋进屋是不被认可的。
en: Wearing shoes inside is {frowned on|frowned upon|disapproved of} in many Kiwi homes.

zh: 我们已经把牛奶都用完了。
en: We've {used up|finished|gone through} all the milk.

zh: 她把明天要穿的衣服都摆好了。
en: She {laid out|set out|put out} her clothes for tomorrow.

zh: 吃晚饭前孩子们能把玩具收好吗？
en: Can the kids {tidy away|put away|pack away|clear away} their toys before dinner?

zh: 他总想找借口不洗碗。
en: He always tries to {wriggle out of|get out of|weasel out of} doing the dishes.

zh: 房东扣了我两百块押金。
en: The landlord {kept back|held back|withheld|kept} two hundred dollars of my bond.

zh: 明天是星期六，我可以睡个懒觉。
en: It's Saturday tomorrow, so I can {lie in|sleep in}.

zh: 他们正在翻修庞森比的一栋老别墅。
en: They're {fixing up|doing up|renovating|restoring} an old villa in Ponsonby.

zh: 我们星期天不得不叫水管工上门。
en: We had to {call out|get in|call|get} a plumber on Sunday.

zh: 最后一个走的人记得锁门。
en: Whoever leaves last, please remember to {lock up}.

zh: 把外套挂在门厅里。
en: {Hang up} your coat in the hall.

zh: 昨晚楼下那户着火了。
en: A fire {broke out|started} in the flat downstairs last night.

zh: 猫把我的水杯打翻了。
en: The cat {tipped over|knocked over} my glass of water.

zh: 卖房前我们把房子拾掇了一下。
en: We {spruced up|did up|tidied up|smartened up|fixed up} the house before selling it.

zh: 我把碎玻璃扫干净了。
en: I {swept up|cleaned up} the broken glass.

zh: 我们不在家的时候有人闯进来了。
en: Someone {broke in} while we were away.

zh: 你洗碗，我来擦干。
en: You wash and I'll {dry up|dry}.

zh: 这个暖气会散发出一股怪味。
en: The heater {gives off|puts out|emits|releases} a weird smell.

zh: 冰箱后面很快就会积灰。
en: Dust {builds up|collects|gathers|accumulates} behind the fridge really quickly.

zh: 我们买房子的计划泡汤了。
en: Our plans to buy the house {fell through|fell apart|collapsed}.

zh: 我清理柜子的时候偶然发现了一些老照片。
en: I {came across|found|stumbled upon|stumbled across|ran across} some old photos while I was sorting the cupboard.

zh: 我们下周要装热泵。
en: We're getting a heat pump {put in|installed|fitted} next week.

zh: 你收到房东的消息了吗？
en: Have you {heard from|heard back from} the landlord yet?

zh: 他总能找借口不洗碗。
en: He always {gets out of|avoids|dodges|wriggles out of} doing the dishes.

zh: 我不小心把一杯水碰倒在笔记本电脑上了。
en: I accidentally {knocked over|spilled|spilt|tipped over} a glass of water on my laptop.

zh: 今天早上我的闹钟没响。
en: My alarm didn't {go off|ring} this morning.

zh: 我收拾车库的时候偶然翻到一张我们的旧照片。
en: I {ran across|came across|stumbled across|stumbled upon|found} an old photo of us while clearing out the garage.

zh: 我们周六去看了一套出租的房子。
en: We {looked round|looked around|viewed|saw} a flat for rent on Saturday.

zh: 天冷了，我得把旧冬衣翻出来。
en: It's getting cold. I need to {dig out|find|pull out|get out|hunt out} my old winter coat.

zh: 上周末我们把圣诞装饰拆下来了。
en: We {took down|removed} the Christmas decorations last weekend.

zh: 你做饭了，那我来洗碗。
en: You cooked, so I'll {wash up|do the dishes}.

zh: 我把吐司烤糊了，触发了烟雾报警器。
en: I burnt the toast and {set off|triggered} the smoke alarm.

zh: 我累了，要去睡了。
en: I'm tired. I think I'll {turn in|go to bed|head to bed|hit the sack}.

zh: 周六我睡了个懒觉。
en: I {slept in|lay in|had a lie-in} on Saturday.

zh: 我昨晚被锁在公寓门外了。
en: I got {locked out} of my flat last night.

zh: 我一直还没腾出时间修大门。
en: I haven't {got around to|gotten around to|got round to|gotten round to} fixing the gate yet.

zh: 他们把房子卖了，搬到了科罗曼德尔。
en: They {sold up} and moved to the Coromandel.

zh: 用吸尘器把那些面包屑吸掉。
en: Use the vacuum to {suck up|vacuum up|hoover up|pick up} those crumbs.

zh: 我发现室友在我房间里乱翻。
en: I caught my flatmate {nosing around|snooping around|poking around|snooping} in my room.

zh: 我找钥匙找了一上午。
en: I've been {looking for|searching for|hunting for} my keys all morning.

zh: 孩子们把客厅弄得一团糟。
en: The kids {messed up|trashed} the lounge.

zh: 把你的靴子放在火炉旁边烘干。
en: Leave your boots by the fire to {dry out|dry}.

zh: 这块污渍能洗掉吗？
en: Will this stain {come out|wash out|come off}?

zh: 我去烧壶水，你要喝茶吗？
en: I'll {put on|boil|switch on} the kettle. Do you want a cup of tea?

zh: 今年房租又涨了。
en: Rents {went up|rose|increased} again this year.

zh: 退租时你拿回押金了吗？
en: Did you {get back|get|receive} your bond when you moved out?

zh: 如果大家都帮把手，一个小时就能打扫完。
en: If everyone {pitches in|helps out|chips in|helps}, we'll have it cleaned up in an hour.

zh: 太阳太晒了，你能把百叶窗拉下来吗？
en: Can you {pull down|close|lower|draw} the blinds? The sun's too strong.

zh: 我用毛巾把地上的水吸干了。
en: I {mopped up|wiped up|soaked up|cleaned up} the water on the floor with a towel.

zh: 新室友下周六搬进来。
en: Our new flatmate {moves in} next Saturday.

zh: 回收之前把罐子冲干净。
en: {Wash out|Rinse out|Rinse|Clean out|Wash} the jars before recycling them.

zh: 别把那个箱子扔了，我还要用。
en: Don't {throw away|throw out|chuck out|chuck|bin|toss} that box. I need it.

zh: 这次装修比我们预想的麻烦多了。
en: The renovation was a lot more work than we'd {bargained for|expected|planned for}.

zh: 我的钥匙最后在沙发底下找到了。
en: My keys {turned up|showed up} under the couch.

zh: 别把脏袜子到处乱丢。
en: Don't leave your dirty socks {lying around|lying about}.

zh: 等一下，我去拿钥匙。
en: {Hang on|Hold on|Wait}, I'll just grab my keys.

zh: 出门前我们把总水阀关掉了。
en: We {shut off|turned off|switched off} the water at the mains before we left.

zh: 我在洗澡，你能去给送货的人开门吗？
en: I'm in the shower. Can you {let in|buzz in} the delivery guy?

zh: 碗你别管了，我来处理。
en: Don't worry about the dishes, I'll {see to|deal with|take care of|sort out|handle|do} them.

zh: 我今晚好累，我们就在家吃吧。
en: I'm so tired. Let's {eat in|stay in|eat at home} tonight.

zh: 他们立刻着手打扫房子。
en: They {set about|got on with|got started on|started|began} cleaning the house straight away.

zh: 那栋老房子下个月要被拆掉。
en: The old house is going to be {knocked down|pulled down|demolished|torn down} next month.
